mode: read-only source review; no builds or tests
finding: No actionable source-level correctness defect found.
reasoning: Basis expression is the same Float 1/sqrt(8) as the zero-frequency matrix entry; cos(0)=1. Dequantisation and both Float multiplications remain separate, followed by centring.
For finite values, clamp nesting order is equivalent to existing ScalarDSP. Signed zero cannot become a negative output after adding the positive 8/12-bit centre under ordinary rounding.
Public SequentialGreyscalePlan already admits only precision8/12. Validated DC magnitude <=2^(precision+2) and integer JPEG quantiser <=65535 keep intermediate Float values finite.
Entropy decoding, caller output borrow, batch ownership, restart/cancellation and resource admission are unchanged.

The new rejection of private synthetic NaN/infinity values happens before the batch reaches caller storage. This is deliberately stricter than scalar clipping, but not reachable from admitted JPEG integer DC/quantiser inputs.
testReview: New tests compare finite bit patterns against scalar/accelerated DSP contexts and check NaN/infinity rejection; runtime results were not inspected or produced in this review.
